renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Outer quit, noble dwelt, undivided shown; ends grasped.

paragraphs.text: To leave outer work behind, to dwell in noble knowing-ground: when You show that things are undivided, waves gone fickle — then grasp, goddess, the end of maintenance itself. And then may You grasp ever, Lord, the undoing of my wandering state.
